name: global-equity-etf/trend-flow-blend
title: Trend-flow blend — country trend + FOMC + two month-end rebalancing sleeves
description: Four country-ETF sleeves at IS-fixed equal risk: 0.490 × the slow US-vs-ex-US relative trend (market-neutral, month-end), 0.605 × a long EW country basket over FOMC day −1/0, 0.861 × the stock/bond month-end rebalancing pressure on 0.6 SPY + 0.4 EFA (last 4 sessions), and 0.672 × the US-vs-EFA month-end rebalancing spread (EFA − β·SPY on the last session); per-session gross cap 4.

backtest.cost_type: research: 5 bp/side country ETFs, 2 bp EFA, 1 bp SPY on |dw| (turnover-weighted 2.50 bp); price (auto-adjusted) returns, no financing on cash or leverage

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close from the shared data/ cache, with no order book, rejection or partial fill, and no margin interest on levered days. Weaker evidence than a venue fill -- do not read this track as exchange-cleared.

SUPERSEDES global-equity-etf/global-etf-sleeve-blend (daily corr 0.86; the spec says deploy one or the other). The deployment agent does not stop earlier strategies: an operator should retire global-etf-sleeve-blend.

Cost: SimPortfolioBroker takes one rate; built as 1.0 bp slippage + 1.5 bp fee = 2.5 bp/side, the turnover-weighted research cost (SPY 37.5 % / EFA 33.3 % / countries 29 % of 2003-26 turnover at 1/2/5 bp). Aggregate matches the research; per leg the countries are under-charged by 2.5 bp and SPY/EFA over-charged. Report: costs x2 -> 1.13 full / 0.99 OOS. live_lib.broker_from_meta (flatten button) rebuilds with the 1 bp / 10 bp defaults -- affects a one-off flatten only.

IEF is a signal-only input (rebalance sleeve's stock-minus-bond drift). The runner refreshes it and refuses to trade if IEF (or any leg) has not printed SPY's bar -- a stale IEF silently switches the rebalance sleeve off (seen at deploy time on a stale cache).

Timing is critical: three of four sleeves trade calendar-dated sessions (FOMC -1/0, last 4 / last 1 session of the month); a +1 session lag drops the blend to 0.52. Row t of target_weights is held close_t -> close_{t+1}; the daemon wakes 00:00:20 UTC and trades only the newly printed bar. A missed night is not recoverable for the flow sleeves.
Gross cap 4.0 = strategy.GROSS_CAP (max observed 3.97, never bound 2003-26); if the journal shows scaled_by, the book is outside what the research tested.

Calendar upkeep: code/global-equity-etf/shared/trading_calendar.py NYSE_HOLIDAYS covers through 2027 and code/global-equity-etf/fomc-global-beta/fomc_snapshot.csv to 2027-12. Extend both before 2028 (runner warns within 90 days of either end).

Selection caveat (report): the two new sleeves were designed with the full sample in view, so OOS 1.15 is not a clean hold-out for them; expect ~+0.2 Sharpe over the old blend, not +0.34. Recent decay: 2024-26 FOMC sleeve -0.81, rebalance 0.36, intl-flow 1.51; blend 0.68.

Deploy check 2026-11-28: runner --check on bar 2026-11-27 equals strategy.target_weights recomputed over the research panel exactly (max|diff| 0.0, lag 0; no saved weight series in the PR to compare against). Gross 0.80, net +0.26; EWC +0.209, EWJ +0.170, INDA -0.103, EWU +0.081, SPY -0.066, FXI -0.057, EFA -0.026. 2026-11-30 is the last November session, so both month-end sleeves are active (rebalance SPY +0.259/EFA +0.173 pre-mult, intl-flow EFA -0.259/SPY +0.235); FOMC off.
